theoryBody1: 2D Strip/Bin Packing is a classic NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem where parts must be cut from plate material with zero void.
theoryBody2: WaSHI linearizes coordinate positioning, rotation disjunctions, and pairwise non-overlap conditions via Big-M Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), solved to optimality with HiGHS.
